status: Read-only official-source investigation; not implemented or claimed supported.

sources.observation: The official loader first reads a modern property map, falls back to its legacy JSON converter, and reconstructs a position list. Saving uses property-map JSON; filename suffix alone does not identify the schema.
Each labelled position can carry multiple named devices plus default XY/focus devices. Selecting arbitrary first coordinates would lose the explicit device selection.
Device positions have axis counts and coordinates; the one-axis focus coordinate occupies the first stored coordinate, so a generic x/y/z object parser would be incorrect.
The maintained legacy conversion handles independent position lists and metadata-embedded lists as distinct forms.
Current keys and legacy aliases coexist, including labels, default XY/focus device names and position-list containers.

remaining_design_requirements: Use recognized version/schema structures and real official exported fixtures, rejecting ambiguity rather than inferring from a filename suffix.
Map the list position label deliberately to the exact spaCR watch field key; generic labels do not automatically establish that identity.
Select declared default devices and validate dimensionality/finite coordinates, duplicate labels and missing or ambiguous devices.
Coordinate supported-format description and microscope_positions tooltip with Original Home settings owner before making .pos a user-facing promise.
ownership: No parser/settings edits for .pos are authorized by this inspection alone. Existing three-function grant is retained for reproduced driver repairs.
